modules.title: Introduction to Pesticides and Agrochemicals
lessons: L1: History and Evolution of Pesticide Use
L2: Classification of Pesticides: Insecticides, Herbicides, Fungicides
L3: Key Agrochemical Inputs: Fertilizers, Plant Growth Regulators
L4: Global Market Trends and Major Manufacturers
L5: Regulatory Frameworks: EPA, EU, and International Standards
L6: Case Study: The Green Revolution and Agrochemical Adoption

modules.title: Chemistry and Formulation of Pesticides
lessons: L1: Active Ingredients and Mode of Action
L2: Common Chemical Classes: Organophosphates, Carbamates, Pyrethroids
L3: Formulation Types: Emulsifiable Concentrates, Wettable Powders, Granules
L4: Adjuvants, Surfactants, and Synergists
L5: Stability, Shelf Life, and Storage Conditions
L6: Lab Exercise: Reading and Interpreting Pesticide Labels

modules.title: Toxicology and Human Health Effects
lessons: L1: Routes of Exposure: Dermal, Inhalation, Oral
L2: Acute vs. Chronic Toxicity and LD50/LC50 Concepts
L3: Carcinogenicity, Neurotoxicity, and Endocrine Disruption
L4: Pesticide Poisoning: Symptoms and First Aid
L5: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Selection and Use
L6: Case Study: Health Impacts in Agricultural Communities

modules.title: Environmental Fate and Ecotoxicology
lessons: L1: Persistence, Bioaccumulation, and Biomagnification
L2: Soil Sorption, Leaching, and Groundwater Contamination
L3: Spray Drift, Volatilization, and Atmospheric Transport
L4: Effects on Non-Target Organisms: Bees, Birds, Aquatic Life
L5: Pesticide Resistance and Secondary Pest Outbreaks
L6: Field Exercise: Water and Soil Sampling for Residue Analysis

modules.title: Application Techniques and Equipment
lessons: L1: Sprayer Types: Boom, Knapsack, Airblast, Aerial
L2: Nozzle Selection and Calibration for Target Coverage
L3: Spray Volume, Droplet Size, and Drift Management
L4: Seed Treatment and Soil Injection Methods
L5: Maintenance and Cleaning of Application Equipment
L6: Practical: Calibrating a Boom Sprayer in the Field

modules.title: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) and Sustainable Use
lessons: L1: Principles of IPM: Monitoring, Thresholds, and Decision Making
L2: Biological Control and Biopesticides
L3: Cultural and Mechanical Control Methods
L4: Rotating Modes of Action to Prevent Resistance
L5: Precision Agriculture and Variable Rate Application
L6: Case Study: Successful IPM Programs in Row Crops

modules.title: Regulatory Affairs and Registration
lessons: L1: Pesticide Registration Process: Data Requirements
L2: Risk Assessment and Risk Management Approaches
L3: Maximum Residue Limits (MRLs) and International Trade
L4: Labeling Requirements and Safety Data Sheets (SDS)
L5: Compliance and Enforcement: Inspections and Penalties
L6: Workshop: Preparing a Mock Registration Dossier

modules.title: Residue Analysis and Quality Control
lessons: L1: Sampling Techniques for Fresh Produce and Grains
L2: Extraction and Cleanup Methods: QuEChERS, SPE
L3: Analytical Instrumentation: GC-MS, LC-MS/MS
L4: Method Validation, Limits of Detection, and Quantification
L5: Quality Assurance and Good Laboratory Practice (GLP)
L6: Lab Exercise: Analyzing Pesticide Residues in a Food Sample

modules.title: Agrochemicals in Crop Production
lessons: L1: Fertilizer Types: Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, Micronutrients

L5: Community and Environmental Incident Reporting
L6: Drill: Simulating a Pesticide Spill Cleanup

L6: Case Study: Evaluating a Novel Biopesticide

modules.title: Capstone Project and Future Perspectives
